_comment: Update manifest. `web` is the latest web build — it MUST equal the ?v=N in index.html on every release; js/update.js reads it fresh (no-store) and reloads the entry html so web/CSS/JS updates reach all devices without a reinstall. `apk` only triggers the in-app 'download new APK' banner when apk.build here is GREATER than the versionCode installed on the device. To release a NEW APK: bump android/app/build.gradle versionCode, build, upload to Drive, then set apk.build to that number + apk.url to the new Drive share link + notes, and push.

apk.notes_ar: إصلاح أيقونة التطبيق. كان يظهر روبوت أندرويد على مربّع أسود — لأن ملف أيقونة افتراضياً من Capacitor في مجلّد drawable-v24 كان يحجب أيقونة VAULT في مجلّد drawable. حُذف المُلف الحاجب، والأيقونة الآن حرف V برتقالي على أسود.
apk.notes_en: App icon fix. It was showing the Android robot on a black tile: a leftover stock Capacitor vector in drawable-v24 was shadowing the VAULT icon in drawable, and the -v24 qualifier always wins at minSdk 26. The shadowing file is gone; the icon is the orange V on black.
